headline: Charlie Manby wins first PDC title at Players Championship 31
standfirst: The 21-year-old beat Maik Kuivenhoven 8-2 in Den Bosch to win his first senior ranking title and qualify for the Grand Slam of Darts.
body: Charlie Manby won his first senior PDC ranking title at Players Championship 31 in Den Bosch, beating Maik Kuivenhoven 8-2 in the final. The 21-year-old averaged 99.72 in the final, against 84.76 from Kuivenhoven.

Manby was strong throughout the day. He opened with a 104.01 average in a 6-1 win over Karel Sedlacek, then beat Dennie Olde Kalter 6-5 and Adam Leek 6-4. His best display was a 112.17 average against Dominik Gruellich in the last 16, the highest of the event.
He then beat Alan Soutar 6-3 in the quarter-finals and Beau Greaves 7-5 in the semi-finals.
Kuivenhoven was playing in his second floor final of the year, according to Dartsnews, having lost the first in Wigan. He beat Mike De Decker 6-2 and Dirk van Duijvenbode 7-6 on his way to the final.
The title also earned Manby a place at the Grand Slam of Darts in Wolverhampton. He told the PDC he had always believed he was good enough to win one.
